about_the_game:
Tralalero Tralala, Bombardino Crocodilo, Lirili Larila, Tung Tung Tung Sahur – do you recognize these unusual characters?

MEMOLOGY: ITALIAN BRAINROT is a new exciting sequel to the famous MEMOLOGY game series. In this version, you will not only use your intelligence, but also seriously train your memory, trying to remember all the unique neural network animals of Italian origin!

You will have a fascinating journey through the amazing world of virtual creatures, each of which has a special character and unique features. Can you accurately distinguish these characters and name each of them correctly? Let's check your knowledge together!

  • Classic test format in the best traditions of the MEMOLOGY series;

  • 30 fascinating questions of varying degrees of difficulty;

  • Unique achievement system with Italian animals;

  • Exciting final result: find out which Italian animal YOU are!

  • An opportunity to evaluate how much time you've wasted studying these amazing creatures (and whether it was worth it...)

Does this challenge seem easy to you? Dive into the game and test how well you remember these magical creatures. Good luck on your adventure in the world of Italian animals!
